# Introduction
This file converts completed membership matrix templates into crosswalk tables for the Atlas synthesis process.


# Housekeeping
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(glue) #for string manipulation
library(fs) #for file system operations
library(readxl)  #for reading excel files
library(googlesheets4) #for reading google sheets
library(tidyverse)  #for data wrangling etc
rm(list=ls())
```


# Load efg information
Need both pixel values and efg codes as separate objects for pipeline
### Pixel values
```{r}
efg_pixelvalues <- read_csv( "https://storage.googleapis.com/gea_inference_maps_prod_distribution/pixel_values/v1_0_0/gea_efg_pixel_values.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  rename(efg_code = efg_code, 
         efg_name = efg_name, 
         efg_description = efg, 
         pixel_value = efg_pixel_value) |> 
  # mutate no data efg_code to 0 as this gets dropped during the read_csv above 
  mutate(efg_code = replace(efg_code, pixel_value == 0, "0")) |> 
  mutate(efg_code = as.character(efg_code)) |> 
  mutate(efg_code = replace_na(efg_code, "NA"))

```


### EFG codes
```{r}
efg_codes <- efg_pixelvalues |>
  pull(efg_code) |> 
  unique()
efg_pixelvalues |> count(efg_code) |> filter(n > 1)
```



# Specify input and output directories
```{r}
input_folder <- here::here("resources/02-membership-matrix-complete")
output_folder <- here::here("resources/03_cw_tables_GEA")
dir_create(output_folder)
```


# Function to process membership matrix template for one dataset
# For each class in each membership matrix we need to assess which EFG code has the highest membership score. If that score is below a threshold (currently 0.5) then we assign "NA" for that class. If there are no membership scores for a class, we also assign "NA". If two EFG codes both score 0.5, we will also assign "NA".

```{r}
process_membmat <- function(file_path, membership_threshold = 0.5) { 
  
  # Derive data_id_code from folder name
  data_id <- basename(dirname(file_path))
  
  # Read membership matrix
  dat <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    # Using any_of() ensures the loop won't break if a file already uses "NOTREF" instead of "NA"
    rename(any_of(c(NOTREF = "NA"))) |> 
    mutate(
      crossref_date               = as.character(crossref_date),
      crossref_by                 = as.character(crossref_by),
      data_id_code                = as.character(data_id_code),
      layer_id                    = as.integer(layer_id),
      layer_name                  = as.character(layer_name),
      in_class_field_name         = as.character(in_class_field_name),
      in_class_value              = as.character(in_class_value),
      in_class_description        = as.character(in_class_description),
      in_class_description_detail = as.character(in_class_description_detail),
      GET_vsn                     = as.double(GET_vsn),
      Source_ID                   = as.double(Source_ID)
    )  
  
  # Pivot longer across all EFG codes
  dat_long <- dat |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(efg_codes),
      names_to = "efg_code",
      values_to = "membership"
    )
  
  dat_out <- dat_long |> 
    group_by(data_id_code, layer_name, in_class_value) |> 
    # Calculate if the maximum membership score is shared by more than one EFG
    mutate(
      max_mem = max(membership, na.rm = TRUE),
      is_tie = sum(membership == max_mem, na.rm = TRUE) > 1
    ) |> 
    # Sort to bring maximum membership to the top of the group
    arrange(desc(membership), .by_group = TRUE) |> 
    slice_head(n = 1) |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    # If winning candidate failed threshold, was tied, or is NA, assign "NOTREF" for efg_code
    mutate(
      efg_code = if_else(is_tie | is.na(membership) | membership < membership_threshold, "NOTREF", efg_code)) |> 
    select(-max_mem, -is_tie)

  # Join with metadata
  dat_out <- dat_out |>
    left_join(efg_pixelvalues, by = "efg_code") |>
    select(
      crossref_date,
      crossref_by,
      GET_vsn,
      Source_ID,
      data_id_code,
      layer_id,
      layer_name,
      in_class_field_name,
      in_class_value,
      in_class_description,
      in_class_description_detail,
      efg_code,
      efg_name,
      efg_description,
      pixel_value
    ) |>
    arrange(data_id_code, layer_name, in_class_value)
  
  # Define output subdir and ensure it exists
  sub_dir <- path(output_folder, data_id)
  dir_create(sub_dir)
  
  # Save
  save_path <- path(sub_dir, glue::glue("{data_id}_GEA_crosswalk_table.csv"))
  write_csv(dat_out, save_path)
  
  
  # Create one csv file per band layer in the sub-folder 'per_layer_name'
  split_dir <- path(sub_dir, "per_layer_name")
  dir_create(split_dir)
  
  dat_out |>
    group_split(layer_id) |>
    walk(function(df) {

      split_filename <- glue::glue("cwt_{df$Source_ID[1]}_{df$layer_id[1]}.csv")
      split_save_path <- path(split_dir, split_filename)
      
      write_csv(df, split_save_path)
    })

  message("Processed: ", data_id)
}
```

# Process all membership matrix files
```{r}
dir_ls(input_folder, recurse = TRUE, regexp = "-membmat-complete\\.csv$") |>
  walk(process_membmat)
```


# Combine all per-dataset crosswalk tables into one global csv
```{r}
# Explicit col types so type-guessing per-file (e.g. in_class_value as
# character in one dataset, double in another) doesn't break bind_rows()
crosswalk_col_types <- cols(
  crossref_date                = col_character(),
  crossref_by                  = col_character(),
  GET_vsn                      = col_double(),
  Source_ID                    = col_double(),
  data_id_code                 = col_character(),
  layer_id                     = col_integer(),
  layer_name                   = col_character(),
  in_class_field_name          = col_character(),
  in_class_value               = col_character(),
  in_class_description         = col_character(),
  in_class_description_detail  = col_character(),
  efg_code                     = col_character(),
  efg_name                     = col_character(),
  efg_description              = col_character(),
  pixel_value                  = col_double()
)

all_crosswalks <- dir_ls(
  output_folder,
  recurse = TRUE,
  regexp = "_GEA_crosswalk_table\\.csv$"
) |>
  map_df(read_csv, col_types = crosswalk_col_types)

write_csv(all_crosswalks, path(output_folder, "all_GEA_crosswalk_tables.csv"))

message("Combined ", n_distinct(all_crosswalks$data_id_code), " datasets into all_GEA_crosswalk_tables.csv")
```
